{{Short description|American mathematician (born 1936)}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=December 2024}}
{{Use American English|date=December 2024}}
'''Denny Gulick''' (born '''Sidney Lewis Gulick III''', July 29, 1936)<ref>{{cite web |url=https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/cb12338319r |title=Notice de personne 'Gulick, Denny (1936-....)' |date=July 13, 1993 |publisher=Catalogue général, [[Bibliothèque nationale de France]] |lang=fr}}</ref> is an emeritus professor of mathematics at [[University of Maryland, College Park]].

==Life==
Gulick graduated from [[Oberlin College]], Ohio, then obtained his PhD from [[Yale University]],<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www-math.umd.edu/people/faculty/item/320-dgulick.html |title=Gulick, Denny |publisher=Department of Mathematics - University of Maryland}}</ref> with his main interest of [[operator theory]].<ref>{{cite web |title= Denny Gulick, Ph.D |work= East Asian Science and technology web site |publisher= University of Maryland |url= http://www.oit.umd.edu/AS/EAST/Gulick.HTM |access-date= May 7, 2010 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100613120536/http://www.oit.umd.edu/AS/EAST/Gulick.HTM |archive-date= June 13, 2010 |url-status= dead }}</ref> He was the undergraduate chair of the Mathematics Department at the University of Maryland and was active in statewide college education and policies.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Department of Mathematics - Mathematician Denny Gulick Reflects on His 58-Year Career at UMD |url=https://www-math.umd.edu/newsletter-single/1031-mathematician-denny-gulick-reflects-on-his-58-year-career-at-umd.html |access-date=2026-04-06 |website=www-math.umd.edu}}</ref>

He has written several textbooks, including ''Encounters with Chaos'' (1992) and six editions of ''Calculus with Analytic Geometry'', with fellow University of Maryland math professor Robert Ellis.
